cases.title: Initiate drag event on product item
cases.description: Verify that dragging a product item with draggable set to true successfully captures the title and price for transfer.

cases.title: Drag product item with missing attributes
cases.description: Verify the system behavior when attempting to drag an item that lacks necessary data-testid attributes for title or price.

cases.title: Attempt drag on non-draggable element
cases.description: Verify that elements without the draggable attribute set to true cannot trigger the product drag event.

cases.title: Drop single product item into drop area updates cart display
cases.description: Verify that dragging and dropping a product item (data-testid='product-item-1') into the designated drop area (id='div1', data-testid='drop-area') successfully updates the cart display with the correct quantity in .box1, product title in .box2, and unit price in .box3.

cases.title: Drop multiple different product items into drop area
cases.description: Verify that dropping multiple distinct product items (e.g., 'product-item-1' and 'product-item-2') sequentially into the drop area adds all items to the cart and updates the cart display rows accordingly.

cases.title: Drop repeated product items increments quantity correctly
cases.description: Verify that dropping the same product item multiple times into the drop area properly handles repeated products by incrementing the quantity in .box1 rather than creating duplicate independent rows.

cases.title: Calculate and Display Total Price with Standard Currency Symbol and Two Decimal Places
cases.description: Verify that when products are added to the cart, the system calculates the total price correctly, formats it to two decimal places with the appropriate currency symbol (e.g., '$80.00'), and displays it in the <div id="allMoney"> element.

cases.title: Calculate Total Price with Mixed Decimal Values
cases.description: Verify that the total price calculation correctly handles items with varying decimal values, summing them accurately and displaying the correctly formatted total in <div id="allMoney">.

cases.title: Calculate Total Price for Large Quantities of Repeated Items
cases.description: Verify that when large quantities of repeated items are added, the system correctly aggregates the prices and displays the updated total in <div id="allMoney"> without precision errors.

cases.title: Display Total Price for an Empty Cart State
cases.description: Verify that when the cart is empty, the total price displayed in <div id="allMoney"> reflects a zero balance with proper formatting (e.g., '$0.00').

opinions.feedback: The proposed cases are generally clear and cover the core requirements, but case G-002 tests an edge case for missing attributes that are not specified as variable user behaviors or requirements. All other scenarios are well-defined.
All test cases are well-structured, directly mapped to valid requirements, and test feasible functionalities of the system. No blockers identified.

analysis.analysis: For requirement e2edev_bench_01-R-1, the normal scenario involves dragging a product item (e.g., product-item-1) to initiate a drag event that successfully captures the title (product-title-1) and price (product-price-1). Actionable missing scenarios include edge cases such as dragging an item with missing data-testid attributes or verifying that non-draggable elements cannot trigger the drag event. For requirement e2edev_bench_01-R-3, the normal scenario covers dropping a product item into the drop area (id='div1', data-testid='drop-area') and verifying updates to the cart display (.box1 for quantity, .box2 for title, .box3 for unit price). Actionable missing scenarios include dropping multiple different products sequentially and dropping repeated products to increment quantities correctly. For requirement e2edev_bench_01-R-5, the normal scenario calculates and displays the total price formatted to two decimal places with the currency symbol in <div id='allMoney'>. Actionable missing scenarios include calculating totals with mixed decimal values, large quantities of repeated items, and an empty cart total state.
